name: Broom of Flying
description: A plain birch broom that tugs gently upward when held.
body:
## What it does

Standing astride it, you fly at 50 feet, or 30 if it carries more than 200 pounds. Speak its word and name a place within a mile and it flies there alone, and it comes back to you from that far when called.

features.name: Burdened
features.text: It flies at 30 feet while carrying over 200 pounds, and stops carrying more than 400.
